summary: This document discusses the security implications of native IPv6 support and IPv6 transition mechanisms on networks that are thought of as IPv4-only. It also describes possible mitigations. Even if you never turned IPv6 on, devices may still speak it.

eli5.summary: Locking your front door does not help if a hidden side door is open. Even a building that thinks it only has one door may have another one, and this explains how to lock it.
